حالت‌های آپ‌لینک (ترنسپورت و عبور از فیلترینگ)

MIRRLY UPLINK ARCHITECTURE: • Upstream Tunnel defines the physical and cryptographic network route from local SOCKS5 proxy (127.0.0.1:10808) to تلگرام data centers via censorship gateways. • Messenger traffic is encapsulated into modern protocols disguised as regular web surfing or tunneled through Cloudflare Anycast infrastructure. • Unlike system VPN, Mirrly operates as a local transparent TCP relay without creating a TUN interface, preventing DNS leaks, battery drain, and OS restrictions. 1. CLOUDFLARE WORKER (WEBSOCKET OVER TLS 1.3): • How it works: traffic traverses an encrypted WebSocket tunnel (port 443) to a serverless V8 function on Cloudflare Edge. ورکر connects to تلگرام data centers using internal socket API (cloudflare:sockets). • Bypass mechanism: telecom carriers and DPI see a standard HTTPS request with a trusted TLS 1.3 certificate of a global CDN, bypassing protocol inspection. • Quota: Cloudflare free plan offers 100,000 requests per day. Thanks to multiplexing, this quota is virtually impossible to exhaust during everyday use. 2. CLOUDFLARE WARP (MASQUE / RFC 9484): • How it works: state-of-the-art IETF CONNECT-IP / CONNECT-UDP standard over HTTP/3 and QUIC. Connects to Cloudflare Anycast gateways (188.114.96.1) using WireGuard credentials and mTLS certificates (ECDSA P-256). • Advantages: zero Head-of-Line Blocking, minimal round-trip latency, and superior voice and video call quality. • DPI resilience: auto-scans open Anycast ports (500, 8095, 8443, 1074, 443) and applies Noise Handshake Fragmentation. 3. VLESS OVER WEBSOCKET (ANYCAST PAGES CDN): • How it works: lightweight binary VLESS v0 protocol over WebSocket (port 443) with TLS 1.3, masquerading as regular Google Chrome traffic. • Zero-registration: requires no Cloudflare account, API tokens, or custom workers. • Auto pool: includes stable Anycast nodes across Europe and Asia with Happy Eyeballs racing. 4. HYBRID MODE (WORKER + WARP CASCADE): • How it works: two-hop tunneling. Device connects to trusted ورکر over WSS, and ورکر proxies data to WARP Anycast.

HOW MASQUE WORKS (RFC 9484): • MASQUE (Multiplexing Application Substrate over QUIC Encryption, RFC 9484 / RFC 9298) multiplexes IP packets and UDP datagrams over HTTP/3 and QUIC transport layer. • Traffic routes through the nearest low-latency Cloudflare Edge Anycast server. AUTOMATIC PROVISIONING & CRYPTOGRAPHY: • Creates WireGuard / Curve25519 keypair and issues a client mTLS certificate (ECDSA P-256) for mutual authentication. • Allocates dedicated internal IPv4 (172.16.0.2) and IPv6 (/128) addresses. DPI CIRCUMVENTION & HANDSHAKE PACKET FRAGMENTATION: • Bypasses WireGuard handshake filtering via handshake packet fragmentation (splitting init frames below MTU with delayed tail dispatch). • Endpoint scanner automatically finds responsive Anycast ports (8095, 8443, 500, 1074, 443). AMNEZIAWG EXPORT: • Profile parameters and junk packet headers (Init Packet Magic Header I1) can be copied to clipboard for external AmneziaWG clients.

VLESS PROTOCOL FEATURES: • VLESS is a zero-overhead transport protocol (v0) relying on outer TLS 1.3 encryption without inner cipher duplicates. • Masquerades as standard Google Chrome browser traffic (Chrome utls-mimic) on port 443. CLOUDFLARE PAGES INFRASTRUCTURE: • Unlike Workers, Pages nodes operate on global Anycast CDN. *.pages.dev domains carry high trust scores in network firewalls and bypass DPI inspections. DYNAMIC POOL & HAPPY EYEBALLS DUAL-STACK RACE: • Parallel connectivity probing in Rust core (RFC 8305) ensures instantaneous failover between nodes without interrupting active تلگرام sessions. • Subscription streaming engine automatically synchronizes verified nodes from GitHub mirrors with strict filtering (pure WSS-over-TLS only; Reality, gRPC, and raw TCP are stripped). • All verified nodes are cached in persistent local device storage.

PORT CONFIGURATION: • Local listening port is the socket on 127.0.0.1 where تلگرام client connects. • Port 1080: Standard MTProto port with Fake-TLS. • Port 10808: Standard SOCKS5 transparent TCP relay port. RECOMMENDATIONS: • Recommended ports: 1080 (MTProto) and 10808 (SOCKS5). They require no root privileges and are standardized for proxy servers. • Allowed range: 1024 to 65535. • If the selected port is occupied by another application, a Bind Error occurs. • Update تلگرام proxy link after changing ports via \"Connect تلگرام\".

KEY STRUCTURE & CRYPTOGRAPHY: • 32-character hexadecimal (Hex) key used by تلگرام to authenticate and encrypt MTProto session headers. • Prefix \'dd\' activates Fake-TLS mode. • With Fake-TLS, initial handshake mimics a standard TLS 1.3 ClientHello with a legitimate SNI domain. GENERATION & APPLICATION: • Tap the generate icon to create a cryptographically secure random key. • Remember to update your تلگرام proxy settings after generating a new key.

CLOUDFLARE WORKER ARCHITECTURE: • Serverless relay routing TCP traffic to تلگرام data centers via cloudflare:sockets API. • Entire stream is encrypted end-to-end. ISP sees only HTTPS/WSS requests to a trusted global CDN domain on port 443. CUSTOM WORKER DEPLOYMENT: • Deploying a personal free worker guarantees dedicated bandwidth, zero shared pool congestion, and complete privacy. • Cloudflare free tier grants 100,000 requests per day per account. • Configured custom domain receives highest priority in Mirrly routing.

HOW IT WORKS: • Listens for the Android BOOT_COMPLETED broadcast event. • Automatically starts the local proxy socket on system startup without requiring manual app launch. DEVICE-SPECIFIC OEM SETTINGS: • Xiaomi (MIUI/HyperOS): تنظیمات -> Apps -> Permissions -> Autostart -> enable Mirrly TG پروکسی. • Samsung (One UI): Add application to \'Never sleeping apps\'. • Huawei (EMUI/HarmonyOS): Switch app launch to manual and toggle \'Auto-launch\'.

WEBSOCKET PRE-WARMING TECHNOLOGY: • Maintains pre-opened standby socket pools (Pre-Warming Pool) and ring buffers in native core to eliminate handshake latency when opening chats or downloading media. AVAILABLE PROFILES: • Eco (2 sockets, 128 KB buffer): Minimal CPU and RAM footprint (~150 KB). • Balanced (4 sockets, 256 KB buffer): Optimal for everyday messaging. • Turbo (8 sockets, 1 MB buffer): Accelerated media and sticker downloads. • Ultra (16 sockets, 2 MB buffer): Peak throughput for 4K video streams. • Auto (2–16 sockets): Dynamic pool scaling based on bandwidth demands.

NAGLE ALGORITHM (RFC 896): • Controls packet coalescing on local TCP sockets. • Auto: Enables TCP_NODELAY on low latency links (<140ms RTT). • فعال: Immediate packet dispatch for instant messaging response. • غیرفعال: Buffers packets, recommended for high packet-loss 2G connections.
POWER SAVING OPTIMIZATIONS: • Disables particle canvas overlays and animations. • Minimizes Compose redraw phases, saving battery on 90-120Hz AMOLED displays.

PROTOCOL COMPARISON: • MTProto (port 1080): تلگرام native protocol with Fake-TLS and Flowseal Anycast. • SOCKS5 (port 10808): Transparent TCP Relay (RFC 1928), end-to-end encryption, seamless voice/video calls, supports all upstreams (ورکر, WARP, VLESS).

LOCAL SOCKET SECURITY: • By default, 127.0.0.1:10808 socket is open to all local processes. • Setting username and password activates RFC 1929 authentication, preventing unauthorized local apps from using the proxy. • Credentials are automatically embedded into tg://socks links when copied or launched into تلگرام.

BATTERY PROTECTION SYSTEM: • Shuts down proxy below configurable battery threshold (5-25%) with a 5-minute notification warning. • One-tap cancellation in notification. • Triggers upon Android system power saver activation. • Thermal QoS scales down pools if battery temperature exceeds 42°C.

ADAPTIVE QOS & THROTTLING: • Dynamically adjusts socket pool size and buffer limits under thermal stress. • غیرفعال mode runs proxy at peak throughput (16 sockets, 2 MB). • Critical thermal safeguards remain enforced at core level.

DOZE MODE EXEMPTION: • Android freezes network sockets during deep sleep (Doze Mode). • Battery optimization exemption allows proxy to maintain keepalive sockets for incoming تلگرام calls and messages. • Minimal idle standby power consumption (~0.1% per day).

DOH CONCURRENT RACING: • Dispatches DNS queries in parallel over HTTP/2 with TLS 1.3. • Fastest valid response wins; lingering queries are canceled. • Validates IP ranges against تلگرام AS44907, filtering out poisoned ISP responses.

HOW BILLING WORKS:
• On the Cloudflare Workers Free tier, each account is allocated a quota of 100,000 requests per day.
• Quota reset occurs daily at 00:00 Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

WHY WSS SAVES REQUESTS:
• 1 WebSocket connection = exactly 1 Cloudflare request during tunnel establishment (HTTP Upgrade: websocket).
• After tunnel opening, all Telegram data exchange (messages, photos, multi-gigabyte videos, voice calls) flows inside the open socket and DOES NOT generate new requests.

USAGE BENCHMARKS:
• 1 active user uses only 200–800 requests per day (less than 1% of the 100,000 quota).
• Even a group of 10–20 users on a single personal worker consumes no more than 10–15% of the daily limit.

ویژگی‌های عملکردی: • هر نشست WSS ترافیک دیتاسنترهای تلگرام (DC1 تا DC5) را در جریان امن TLS 1.3 کپسوله می‌کند. • در ارتباط پیوسته، سوکت ساعت‌ها باز می‌ماند و تنها ۱ درخواست اولیه مصرف می‌کند.

HOW IT WORKS:
• Comprehensive integral stability scoring of the network tunnel (0 to 100%), computed in real time.
• Combines quality assessment for chats/media files (55%) and audio/video calls (45%).

WHY IT MATTERS:
• Instantly determines connection readiness for all Telegram services.

BENCHMARKS:
• 90–100%: ideal direct channel with no latency.
• 75–89%: stable working connection.
• 50–74%: latency on the carrier side.
• Below 50%: channel degradation or packet loss.

HOW IT WORKS:
• Evaluates delivery reliability and speed of text messages, stickers, photos, and video files over secure TCP/TLS.
• Algorithm gives 50% weight to packet delivery reliability, 30% to round-trip time (RTT), and 20% to queue stability.

WHY IT MATTERS:
• For chats and media, latency up to 200 ms is unnoticeable, but zero packet loss and bufferbloat prevention are critical.

BENCHMARKS:
• 90–100%: ideal instant sending and fast media download.
• 75–89%: stable comfortable messaging.
• 50–74%: moderate transmission speed for large files.
• Below 50%: delays and download failures.

HOW THE CHART WORKS:
• Displays real-time history of each tunnel round-trip time (RTT) sample over the last minute.
• Green dots indicate ideal response (< 80 ms), blue — standard (80–180 ms), yellow — elevated, red — network failure or timeout.

WHY IT MATTERS:
• Visually reveals micro-spikes (Jitter Spikes), cellular tower switches (Cell Handover), and Wi-Fi instability.
• You can tap any point on the chart to inspect the exact timestamp and latency.

HOW THE MATRIX WORKS:
• Analyzes physical network metrics (RTT, jitter, loss, buffer size, and socket pool) to evaluate real-time readiness across 4 key Telegram service types.

SERVICE TYPES:
• Chats & stickers: readiness for instant message sending without queue delay (< 80 ms).
• Photos & voice: high media stream transmission speed with reliable delivery (>= 95%).
• Files & 4K video: socket pool throughput and buffer capacity (up to 2 MB).
• Calls & HD video: Opus audio codec quality and zero video lag.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
• Text traffic is transmitted in short TCP/TLS packets (50–300 bytes).
• With RTT < 80 ms, message sending is instantaneous (single checkmark appears in split second).
• Enabled TCP_NODELAY prevents Nagle algorithm buffering delays.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:\n• Requires a stable stream of at least 150 KB/s and packet delivery reliability >= 95%.\n• Voice messages are cached in fragments: without jitter, playback begins seamlessly without pauses.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:\n• For heavy downloads, proxy core adapts MTProto standby from 1 to 4 connections per active slot and sizes the buffer to measured BDP.\n• Bufferbloat control prevents equipment stalls under peak channel saturation.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:\n• Voice traffic is encoded using wideband Opus codec (48 kHz sample rate).\n• For seamless speech without robotic artifacts, jitter must stay under 15–25 ms with packet loss under 2%.

مدل ریاضی SQI و ITU-T MOS

SQI STABILITY INDEX (0–100%):
• Nonlinear sigmoidal utility function:
 - 45% weight on RTT (gradual decay beyond 60 ms).
 - 25% weight on LTE/Wi-Fi Jitter (penalty for jitter exceeding 10 ms).
 - 30% weight on probe delivery reliability with power loss factor.
• Explicit penalties applied for DPI drops, TLS handshakes, and Cloudflare 429 limits.

ITU-T G.107 VOICE SCORE (MOS 1.00–4.50):
• Transmission factor calculation R = 93.2 - Id(delay) - Ie(Opus impairments).
• Polynomial projection of R into speech perception MOS scale.

Happy Eyeballs ensures fast and reliable dual-stack (IPv6/IPv4) connection establishment.

• How it works: the client attempts an IPv6 connection first. If the handshake does not complete within the specified delay (default 200 ms), a parallel IPv4 connection is initiated. Whichever completes first handles the traffic, while the second is cleanly terminated.
• Choosing a delay: 100 ms favors faster fallback on low-latency networks; 200 ms is the RFC 8305 standard; 300 ms is suited for cellular connections with high jitter.

Controls how the DNS resolver and proxy engine handle internet protocol versions:

• Dual-Stack (IPv4/IPv6) — Default: queries both IPv4 and IPv6, choosing optimal routes via Happy Eyeballs.
• IPv4 Only — Disables IPv6 (AAAA queries). Recommended if your mobile carrier assigns broken local IPv6 routing that leads to connection hangs.
• IPv6 Preferred — Prioritizes IPv6 addresses when routing traffic to تلگرام servers and Cloudflare gateways.

Allows specifying a dedicated Cloudflare Anycast IP and port (e.g. 162.159.193.1:2408 or 188.114.96.1:8095):

• Why use this: in certain regions or ISPs, default Cloudflare WARP IP ranges are blocked by DPI/censorship filters. Connecting to a custom unblocked Anycast IP restores tunnel operation.
• Restoring defaults: clear the input field or click the Reset icon next to the input.

Sets the kernel receive (SO_RCVBUF) and send (SO_SNDBUF) buffer sizes for TCP sockets:

• 128 KB — Minimal footprint, saves RAM on entry-level devices and slow 2G/3G connections.
• 256 KB — Standard balanced default. Minimizes latency jitter (bufferbloat) while maintaining smooth chat sync.
• 512 KB – 1 MB — High throughput. Recommended for streaming high-bitrate video files on 4G/5G and Wi-Fi.
